basis: Static reverse engineering of supplied bytes; no sample execution. ML verdicts and trait scores were not used as proof. Triage pages were inaccessible. No fetched package dependency is involved.

coverage: nonzero XOR-key variants and zero-key near miss
native recorder absent, polling absent, clipboard absent

samples.marker_line: NtHook/Gh0st installer: generalize XOR; require recorder evidence
evidence: Ghidra outer VA 0x00ff1450 writes the embedded 0x49600-byte kernel driver; 0x00ff1770 creates a SERVICE_KERNEL_DRIVER service.
Driver VA 0x00015262 writes beep.sys, NtHook.sys and safemon.dll, installs syscall interception and adds its artifact names to a concealment list.
Driver VA 0x00013446 traverses directory records; 0x000134b8..0x000134d0 removes matching records by link editing or compaction.
Embedded 16-bit BIOS hook saves/replaces INT 13h and patches a disk-read buffer with a relocated far call; existing bootkit finding retained.
safemon VA 0x1000e290 polls key states and handles modifiers, backspace and Enter; VA 0x1000e050 XOR-encodes records before file writes, with foreground-window context from 0x1000e180.
safemon VA 0x10010a30 acquires clipboard data and passes it to the manager send path; GDI capture, remote input dispatch and remote DLL injection coexist.

Gh0st-derived manager RTTI supports the embedded RAT identification. Nested images explain why that identity also appears on containers; the kernel driver does not itself implement all user-mode APIs.
Ghidra VA 0x00401cb0 dispatches configuration modes. Current mode byte at VA 0x00404120 is 3, selecting Active Setup installation at 0x00401900 followed by cleanup at 0x00401390.
VA 0x00401900 obtains its own path, registers a GUID Active Setup StubPath, rewrites/copies itself, and starts the copy.
VA 0x00401150 hides a created iexplore/notepad/calc process, allocates remote memory, writes the DLL pathname and starts resolved LoadLibraryA with CreateRemoteThread.
VA 0x00401260 overwrites LanmanServer ServiceDLL; the code path is present but mode 1 is not selected by the current default configuration.
VA 0x00401390 builds COMSPEC /c del <own-short-path> > nul and launches the cleanup process.
Capstone and Ghidra resolve the .htext detours: repeated identical immediate XORs cancel in pairs, and self-exchanges leave registers unchanged.
The resource tree is empty/zero-filled despite resource extraction code and StormAttack banners. A functioning embedded DDoS payload is not established.

dnfile/dncil resolves CLR entry token 0x0600001a to Main at RVA 0x2354. It creates a hidden work directory, locks input/shows a ransom form, installs persistence, starts recording and launches asynchronous collectors.
StartKeylogger RVA 0x33f0 installs WH_KEYBOARD_LL; HookCallback RVA 0x34a8 appends key codes/timestamps. The companion thread RVA 0x3358 polls keys 1..255 and appends records every 50ms.
ContinuousScreenshot RVA 0x3778 captures PrimaryScreen through CopyFromScreen and saves timestamped JPEG files every 30s.

ClipboardMonitor state machine RVA 0x353c calls OpenClipboard/GetClipboardData, marshals returned data and appends changed content. It requests CF_TEXT but decodes as UTF-16, so correct clipboard decoding is not assured.

ContinuousDataExfiltration state machine RVA 0x5500 reads the same key/clipboard log fields, truncates records and calls SendToC2. SendToC2 state machine RVA 0x5870 serializes data into FormUrlEncodedContent and invokes HttpClient.PostAsync.
StealCookies state machine RVA 0x4da4 reads Chrome Default/Cookies, Base64-encodes up to a capped amount and calls SendToC2; file scraping also passes encoded file contents to that sender.

InstallPersistence RVA 0x3294 writes the executable path under HKCU Run, copies itself to Startup and invokes schtasks /sc onlogon. USBWorm RVA 0x3ba4 copies itself to ready removable drives and writes matching autorun.inf.
BypassUAC RVA 0x4878 writes the ms-settings open-command handler and DelegateExecute before starting fodhelper.exe.

RealEncryption state machine RVA 0x2df4 only targets Desktop/TestFolder and attempts suffixed file replacement. EncryptAES RVA 0x301c assigns a 16-byte key but a 14-byte IV, causing AES setup to fail before output/deletion. The existing attempt-qualified finding is accurate.
ProcessInjection RVA 0x3ca8 only injects a one-byte RET demonstration; debugger API declarations are unused. Neither proves an additional functional payload or anti-debug gate.
The self-assigned HiddenTears/blackcat labels do not establish a recognized ransomware family. Concrete spying, extortion and self-replication establish the verdict despite broken routines.
